headline: 0050 '100-Million Dollar Man Zhe-zhe' Strikes Again! Adds to Position on Taiwan Stock Dip: 'The Most Beautiful Entry Point'
summary: Taiwan stocks closed at 44,719.35 points on the 19th, down 589.33 points, losing the 45,000 level and the quarterly moving average. TSMC closed down NT$30 at NT$2,350 amid growing investor concern.
why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker and carries heavy weight in Taiwan's benchmark index. Its share price strongly influences the index's direction.

impacts.name: TSMC
impacts.why: TSMC closed down NT$30 and is a heavily weighted constituent of the index.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The article cites growing investor concern that Taiwan stocks could keep falling, with TSMC's decline contributing to the index drop.
